tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 'tshe ba chos su 'dzin pa'i lam srol 'gog byed thub pa'i dgongs rgyan bzhugs sau/ /gang gi rmad byung rten 'brel lam/ /blo gros mkhyen pa'i dkyil
'tshe ba chos su 'dzin pa'i lam srol 'gog byed thub pa'i dgongs rgyan bzhugs sau/ /gang gi rmad byung rten 'brel lam/ /blo gros mkhyen pa'i dkyil

tei:div.tei:p: 'tshe ba chos su 'dzin pa'i lam srol 'gog byed thub pa'i dgongs rgyan bzhugs sau// gang gi rmad byung rten 'brel lam// blo gros mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor can// mtshan dpe'i dge legs nyi ma brgya// de ring bdag la snang bar mdzod// sogs rgyal bstan las phyi rol pa/ kla klo ston pa'i rjes 'brang na/ yang dag lam mchog 'di la med/ spang phyir brtse bas cung phul na/ de la srog gcod spang blang gi legs nyes mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun nas gsung brjod mang yang*/ tshig tshogs nyung la sdeb sbyor lam gyis ma bcings/ mchog phal kun gyis go sla chod che gdams ngag tshul du cung brjod na/ spyir mi dge bcu po de dag las kyang srog gcod dang log lta gnyis po 'di sdig che ste/ srog gcod gong na sdig gzhan med// mi dge bcu las ltog lta lci// zer ba de yin/ de yang dmyal ba pa ma gtogs su la yang 'chi ba la mi 'tsher ba med cing rang gi srog 'di las gces pa cung zad kyang med pa'i srog de gcod pa'i sdig pa lhag par che zhing*/ sems can gcig gi srog bcad kyang srog lan lnga brgya 'jal dgos pa dang*/ gzhan yang sems can gcig gi srog bcad kyang bar gyi bskal pa zhig tu dmyal bar gnas dgos pa mdo dran pa nyer bzhag nas gsungs/ de las kyang dkon mchog gi rten bzhengs pa dang dge ba sogs la bsnyad btags nas srog gcod sogs sdig pa'i las byed pa ni lhag par yang lci ste/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ dkon mchog gi rten sdig ltung gis bzhengs/ tshe phyi ma rlung la bskur zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du dge ba byed par rlom nas bla ma rnams khyim du gdan 'dren pa dang*/ dge 'dun pa tshogs pa sogs la sems can bsad pa'i sha khrag 'drenapa ni yon mchod thams cad la srog gcod kyi nyes pa 'go zhing*/ sbyin bdag gis 'tsho ba drang ba yang sbyin bdag la ma dag pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ mchod yul la log pa'i 'tsho bar 'gyur ste/

dge ba las kyang sdig pa che ba yin/ bsad pa 'phral du gso nus pa'i skabs ma gtogs srog gcod kyi sdig gis mi gos pa'i dus med pa'i bla ma rnams kyang sku mdzad phrin las la gnod par nges pas rnam shes bde chen du 'dren nus na ma gtogs srog gcod kyi las 'di la ci nus su 'dzem dgos so// lar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs yin na chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba spangs dgos rgyu yin pa la/ gang du 'gro yang*/ der sems can re'i srog la 'tshe ba byed nas bsad pa'i sha khrag la longs spyod na skyabs 'gro dang ci phyir mi 'gal/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i lugs la mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang skyob pa byed dgos rgyu la/ gang bskyab par bya rgyu'i sems can las ngan pa de la snying rje spu tsam yang med par bskyab bya sems can de bsad nas sha khrag g.yos su byas/ skyob pa po byang chub sems dpa' de'i drung du bzhag tsa na dgyes bzhin du skan sgra theg gis gsol 'gro na de las thu ba dang sdug pa ci yod/ gsang sngags theg pa'i gzhung rnams las/ sha khrag mchod pa gzhung bzhin ma tshogs te// seng ha phra men thugs dang ci 'gal ba// yul gyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la bzod par gsol// zhes gsungs ste/ de ni gsang sngags rgyud sde'i gzhung nas bshad pa/ sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// bza' bca' btung ba phyi yi tshogs// zhes bya ste/ kha zas kyi ched du gsod par mi 'gyur ba'i sdig med kyi sha lnga po tshogs rdzas su rung ba yin la/ de la mi gtsang ba dman par 'dzin/ bsad sha gtsang mar 'dzin na/ gtsang rmer bltas dang bag med spyad// gsungs pas dang blang gi dam tshig dang 'gal na/ chos dang mi mthun bzhin du yon bdag gis kyang sems can bsad/ bla ma yang dga' bzhin bzhes/ dkyil 'khor du yang mchod nas rngam rngam rdzig rdzig byed pa de ni/ phyi bon gnyis kyi chos lugs 'ba' zhig ma gtogs nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs phyogs tsam dri tsam mi bro ba ma zad/

skyabs 'gro'i bslabs bya nas bzung*/ phyi so thar/ nang byang sems/ gsang sngags man gyi sdom dang bslab pa/ dam tshig thams cad chol nyog tu 'gro zhes lung dang bstan bcos kun nas zhib tu gsungs na spang blang dgos pa gzhir bcas/ khyad par srog gcod gcig gi 'bras bu la rnam smin rgyu mthun bdag 'bras sogs sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba yod tshul gyi lo rgyus/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes mtsho mgo de rwa lung gangs chen mtsho gzhung ze ma rgu ru la zug nas nyin lam mang po'i bar du yod pa la/ grub chen gling rje ras pas mtsho nang der gzigs nas bshum/ a kha kha/ dkor ma za/ dkor ma za zhes gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ mtsho nang 'dir bla ma dkor zan zhig gi rnam shes nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal mang po myong gin 'dug gsungs/ de ston par zhus pas rdzu 'phrul gyis mtsho de skad cig la bskam tsa na/ nya chen po zhig gi lus kyis mtsho de'i gar slebs pa la srog chags grangs med pas go mtshams med par gtam te zos pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pas 'gre ldog byed kyin 'dug 'di lta bus las ngan pa su zhig gi skye ba yin lags zhus pas/ 'di gtsang bla rta nag can gyi skye ba yin gsungs/ gtsang bla rta nag can bya ba de ngag nus dang byin rlabs shin tu che zhing*/ 'dre gdon gyis nyen pa rnams la lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis phan pa sogs byung bas dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i mchod gnas su gyur te gshin po'i 'bul ba byas pa sogs la phaṭaḥshar re bsgrags nas rta zog mang po blangs 'gro ba zhig yod pa de yin/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po rdau pha wang chen po zhig gi steng rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor mdzad pas rdo phyed tshal du gas pa'i nang na sbal ba chen po zhig gi lus la srog chags chung ngu grangs med pa 'byar nas zos pas sdug bsngal mi bzod par kha nag deng deng bar 'dug 'di ci lags zhus pas/

'di dmar chog byed pa'i bla ma gcig gi skye ba yin gsungs/ da lta bla ma rnam pa yang*/ yon bdag gi bshas lugs tsho ba dang rgyag pa re byas nas mid pa dang*/ mtsher pa sogs sha khrag gis tshang 'brong gi rtsibs sha 'dar cum mo ba'i steng du bzhag nas drangs tsa na/ mnab gzan de dbu la 'thon/ nang cha rnams byis pas nu ma nu nu mdzad/ phyag shan de kha zhig blangs nas phyi sha rnams dal bus gsol/ bzhes pa zin tsa na zhal snum chi le/ dbu rlangs pa phal le/ sngaragyi de ma yin pa rgya dmar tsig ge ba zhig byas nas dbu btogs 'ong ba 'dug ste/ tshe 'dir gsol gsol ba'i bu lon phyi ma sku lus steng nas 'jal dgos byung tsa na nyi tshe ba'i dmyal gnas su 'o brgyal chen po yod par 'dug pas dmar chog la bag yod blang dor nan tan bya dgos/ ya rabs dam pa'i srol lugs mchog /byams brtse 'dzum pa'i 'od dkar can// mi phyod gtsug tu sus bskur na// 'bras bu ye shes thob phyir ro// rmongs rnams ngan srol bzang du 'dzin// 'ga' la bdud kyi byinarlabs zhugs// de la yon tan chos zhes brjod// cha lugs nang pa'i rtags su cha// 'ga' zhig 'tsho ba chad dogs nas// legs nyes shes kyang mi 'dzem par// dmar chog bzang la rtsi ba rnams// dmyal ba gtsug tu sgrub zhes brjod// cais pa 'di'ang 'jang bla tshul khrims bzang pos dmar chog 'gog pa'i yi ge byas pa 'di chos bzhin mthun na de la rgyab yig bgyi rogs/ chos min gyur na mer bsregs chur bskyur bya rogs zhus bzhin/ lcags 'brug nag pa zla ba'i tshe la chos smra ba'i tshul khrims rgya mtshos kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag nas bris pas dge bar gyur cig// /
